underdog.heading: Why Virginia Tech can keep it close
bullets: Stylistically the matchup favours Virginia Tech by 1.0 points: ball control vs front disruption (-1.0 pts).

Virginia Tech is the better football team by 0.5 points on opponent-adjusted results — but about 74% of that rating is still last season carried forward, and in a portal era last season is a different team (-0.5 pts).
The outcome range is 15.3 points wide at one sigma — p10 -16.0 to p90 +28.0 for Maryland, so a projection of +7.0 still produces results a long way either side of it.
It is early enough that both ratings still lean on preseason belief — it widens the outcome range by about 4%.

The market disagrees by 9.5 points. The market is not the truth, but a gap that large is more often the model missing information (a suspension, a starter, a scheme change) than the market being wrong.
